items.when: A sub-question asks for a player's height, birthplace, or school, and the player is identified by a draft context (team, round, pick, or college).
items.action: Route the first sub-question to the 'draft' table source with the draft year and team/college context; route the second sub-question to the 'player' KG source with the player reference.
items.lesson: The draft table source is the only source with draft-specific attributes (round, pick, college); the player KG source has player attributes (height, birthplace, schools_attended) but lacks draft context.
items.evidence: Records 1104, 1121, 1137, 1140, 1139, 1142: sq1 succeeded with draft table; sq2 succeeded with player KG when player reference was used; failures (1121, 1137) occurred when sq2 used player KG but returned no answers.

items.when: A sub-question asks for the teams a player later played for, and the player is identified by a draft context.
items.action: Route the first sub-question to the 'draft' table source; route the second sub-question to the 'contract' table source with the player reference and a roster/team-history context.
items.lesson: The contract table source is the correct source for player-team history; the draft table source only provides the drafting team, not later teams.
items.evidence: Records 1105, 1118, 1122, 1133, 1141: sq1 succeeded with draft table; sq2 failed when routed to contract table with just player reference, returning no answers or game-log pages instead of team names.

items.when: A sub-question asks for a team's opponent or game outcome on a specific date during a season or playoffs.
items.action: Route to the 'teamgame', 'teamgame_basic', or 'monthly_schedule' table source, and ensure the search entity includes the team reference and the season/date context (e.g., '${ref_1} 1989-90 playoffs May 5').
items.lesson: KG schema is too closed for game-level data (opponents, scores, dates); the table sources are the only ones with game logs.
items.evidence: Records 1108, 1109, 1112, 1113, 1116, 1123, 1125, 1128, 1130, 1132, 1143, 1144, 1147: sq1 succeeded when routed to table source with team+season/date; failures (1123, 1147) occurred when search entity lacked season/date context.
